example_prompt: Add a SasPay hosted checkout page to my order flow.

country.description: Code ISO2, optionnel — présélectionne le pays sur la page de paiement

return_url.description: URL vers laquelle rediriger le client une fois le paiement terminé

fee_charge_mode.description: ADD_ON : les frais s'ajoutent au montant débité au client. DEDUCTED : les frais sont déduits du montant net reversé au marchand. Défaut : configuration du marchand. Pris en compte SEULEMENT si l'option "Autoriser le choix du mode de frais par l'API" (ALLOW_CLIENT_OVERRIDE) est activée sur votre compte, sinon ignoré silencieusement — même garde que sur /payments/softpay/ et /payouts/initialize/.

gotchas: Idempotency-Key is not supported here: calling twice creates two separate sessions (nothing is charged until one is paid).
fee_charge_mode is silently ignored unless the merchant account has ALLOW_CLIENT_OVERRIDE enabled.
The API key needs the PAYIN or BOTH scope, otherwise the call returns 403.

return_url is used at most after a successful payment (and see the card observation below): after a failed or cancelled one it is not used, the customer sees a Retry button and must close the tab, so don't depend on a redirect to your site for failures.

A successful card payment may not redirect to return_url either. SasPay's docs (docs.saspay.me/api-reference/payments/checkout-create) say the hosted page "redirige automatiquement le navigateur du client vers cette URL 3 secondes après confirmation d'un paiement **réussi**", but on 2026-11-01 (maintainer's integration test, Senegal, XOF, sk_test_ key, return_url set) a successful card payment (card issued in France) ended on a FeexPay receipt page ("Paiement réussi", "Propulsé par FeexPay") and the customer was not redirected to return_url. The webhook transaction.success still arrived, and get_checkout_session_status returned status PAID and transaction_status SUCCESS. Asked about it, SasPay's support answered « veuillez utiliser les clés lives pour la partie redirection, normalement vous devez être redirigé en même temps » (reply to the maintainer's ticket of 2026-11-01, read 2026-11-07): it ties the missing redirect to the sk_test_ key, which has not been checked with an sk_live_ key yet. Whatever the key, confirm the order from the webhook or the status, never from the customer coming back.

An sk_test_ key did not prevent a real card charge, and SasPay has no working sandbox. SasPay's docs say the key prefix sets the environment (docs.saspay.me/account-setup): "`environment` : `"LIVE"` (préfixe `sk_live_`, argent réel) ou `"SANDBOX"` (préfixe `sk_test_`, tests sans argent réel)", yet in the same test the card was debited for real (session amount 500 XOF; the FeexPay receipt showed "Montant autorisé 1240 FCFA"). Asked about it, SasPay's support answered « les clés sandbox ne sont pas fonctionnelles, veuillez utiliser les clés lives » (reply to the maintainer's ticket of 2026-11-01, read 2026-11-07). Treat every call as production: test card payments only with an amount you accept to pay, and don't tell testers that an sk_test_ key means no money moves. The verification recorded on this spec (environment: sandbox) was run with an sk_test_ key on 2026-10-17: that label is what test:live records for such a key, not proof of a separate test environment; the API answered normally, and whether such a key moves money on mobile money is not known.

In the same test, choosing Orange Money on the hosted checkout (Senegal) showed a QR code ("Scannez le QR Code avec votre application mobile Orange Money ou Max it pour finaliser le paiement."): it must be scanned from the Orange Money or Max it app on the phone that holds the account, so a tester without that phone at hand cannot finish the payment.
Amounts are decimal strings ("5000.00"), never floats.
open_questions: Are there test cards or a simulator, and does an sk_test_ key also move real money on mobile money? SasPay's support answered only « les clés sandbox ne sont pas fonctionnelles, veuillez utiliser les clés lives » (reply read 2026-11-07); its docs (docs.saspay.me/account-setup) still describe sk_test_ as "tests sans argent réel".

Which processor and currency apply to a card payment on the hosted checkout? The formats page (docs.saspay.me/api-reference/reference/formats) says "`card` | Carte bancaire (Visa/Mastercard, via Stripe) | USD uniquement", but the 2026-11-01 card payment ended on a FeexPay receipt in FCFA, and authorized 1240 FCFA for a 500 XOF session: what makes up the difference (card fees, conversion) is not documented.

Does the hosted checkout redirect to return_url after a successful card payment made with an sk_live_ key? SasPay's support ties the 2026-11-01 case (no redirect, the customer stayed on the FeexPay receipt) to the sk_test_ key: « veuillez utiliser les clés lives pour la partie redirection, normalement vous devez être redirigé en même temps » (reply read 2026-11-07). Not tested with an sk_live_ key yet; only one card payment has been observed, and nothing is known for mobile money operators.
Besides Orange Money in Senegal, which mobile money operators on the hosted checkout ask the payer to scan a QR code rather than confirm on their phone? Not documented.

spans: Le header `Idempotency-Key` n'est pas pris en charge sur cet endpoint : un double appel crée deux sessions distinctes.
Scope de clé API insuffisant (PAYIN requis)
Sur un paiement échoué ou annulé, `return_url` n'est actuellement **pas** utilisée
Montants : chaînes décimales (`"2500.00"`), jamais de flottants.
